newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: DIARY - Singapore Initial Public Offerings -Mar 10.
newsitem.headline: DIARY - Singapore Initial Public Offerings -Mar 10.

text.p: Following is a list of expected initial public share offerings (IPOs) in Singapore.
* Stock Exchange of Singapore (SES) approval granted
COMPANY SHRS CURRENCY/ EXPECTED OPEN/ LEAD
(MLN) PRICE LIST DATE
Amara Holdings -- -- -- --
(Amara Holdings Ltd is a hotel company.)
*Eng Kong 20 S$0.56 Mar 19 DBS
(Eng Kong Holdings is a shipping container service company.
Net proceeds will be used to buy equipment and for working capital. It will list on SESDAQ.)
GES Singapore -- S$ -- --
(GES Singapore Pte Ltd makes personal computers.)
*Gul Tech 40 S$0.58 Mar 17 OUB

(Gul Technologies Singapore, a manufacturer of printed circuit boards and a subsidiary of mainboard-listed diversivied group Tuan Sing Holdings, will use net proceeds for a variety of purposes. It will list on SESDAQ.)
Nera ASA -- -- -- --
(Oslo listed Norwegian telecommunications group Nera ASA has said it has applied for a listing on the SES and is preparing an offering of shares aimed at Singapore investors.)
*Noble Group 51 US$0.88 Mar 14 --

(Hong Kong-based Noble markets, processes and transports industrial and agricultural materials and will be listed on the main board of the SES. It will use net proceeds of US$39.4 million to expand products, acquire vessels and reduce borrowings.)
Raffles Hldngs -- S$ H1 1997 --
(Raffles Holdings is the hotel arm of DBS Land and
manages Singapore's Raffles Hotel.)
Sinochem -- -- -- UOB
(Sinochem Asia Holdings is an arm of the Chinese state oil and commodities company Sinochem. The company has applied to the SES for a listing.)
Winbox Holdings -- -- -- OCBC
(Winbox Holdings Pte Ltd carries out the packaging business of Hong Kong-based Goodwill Investment (Holdings) Ltd and has applied to list on the foreign board of the SES).
Wireless Com -- -- -- --

(Mobile phone operator Wireless Communications Service, 45 percent owned by Thailand-based Total Access Communication, is reportedly considering a listing on the new foreign board of the Stock Exchange of Singapore.)
